postpone.label: Postpone
postpone.line: A blow that gets past your shield cracks you 4 seconds late.
postpone.how: Parry another blow before it lands and it lands at half. It lands on the clay, wherever you are by then.

plating.label: Plating
plating.line: Set 20 of your pool solid over the part of you facing the nearest foe: it takes most of that part's next crack.
plating.how: It holds 20 off your pool's top while it stands. Unspent after 30 seconds, it melts back at 15. It cannot stop a crack that would shatter you.

watch.label: The Watch
watch.line: A Figment's watch shows: while its head is down, how long until it looks up.
watch.how: Its bouts are its own and they never lie: move while it is down (STEALTH.md).

shatter.label: Shatter
shatter.line: A Figment whose shell is near breaking glows; a heavy blow on it then breaks it at once.
shatter.how: Near: its stun past (1 - shatter) of full. Heavy: a blow of power 2 or more (a charge, a finisher, a heavy throw).

receptivity.label: Receptivity
receptivity.line: A mind whose agitation is in its best band shows open, and you may reprogram it without stunning it first.
receptivity.how: Open is the band where its Lachryma yields most: agitate it, then catch it there.

retype.label: Re-type
retype.line: For 20 seconds the tool in your hands strikes as another type: the nearest creature's weakness if you know its kind, else the next type in turn.
retype.how: Know a kind (photograph it, or down it five times) and Re-type finds its weakness for you.

standingRule.label: A Standing Rule
standingRule.line: Write one rule: when you do one thing, another follows, for 5 of your pool.
standingRule.how: /rule lists the choices. Each fires at most once in 3 seconds.

recall.label: Recall
recall.line: Blink back to where you stood 3 seconds ago, your pool as it was then if it was fuller.
recall.how: Nothing is marked: the last 3 seconds are always kept.

footholds.label: Footholds
footholds.line: Set a step of Lachrymite where you are about to be: under your feet in the air, a stair ahead on the ground.
footholds.how: Three may stand at once, each for 6 seconds. Not in a race or a timed course.

makeup.label: A Body's Make-up
makeup.line: Lock on to a creature and you read what it is made of, and so the type that bites it.
makeup.how: A kind read so is known: Re-type finds its weakness from then on.

vow.label: A Vow
vow.line: Swear off one thing and every cost is a quarter less while you keep it. Break it and it cracks you.
vow.how: /vow lists the vows. A broken vow waits 30 seconds before another.

catch.label: The Catch
catch.line: Parry a shot and keep holding the parry: you catch it, and let go to throw it where you aim, half again as hard.
catch.how: Held at most 1.5 seconds, then thrown. Let go of the parry at once and it is sent back as ever.

link.label: The Link
link.line: The last creature you reprogrammed is bound to you: a crack meant for you is split, half on it.
link.how: Bound while it lives and stands within 30 metres. The half is struck on it as an Influence blow, by you.

reactions.label: Reactions
reactions.line: Paint one feeling over another and they react: opposites cancel to bare ground and calm what stands there; two that wedge flare as the old paint's blow.
reactions.how: A reaction a stamp, not a cell. Creatures standing in it take it; you never do.

fuse.label: The Fuse
fuse.line: Fuse the nearest foe. For 8 seconds, every affliction you put on it is delayed. Press again and they all go off at once, each lasting half again as long.
fuse.how: Let the 8 seconds run out and they go off as normal. Hint: set them off on a stunned foe for the most effect.

catchWeather.label: Catch the Weather
catchWeather.line: Stand in a feeling's weather, out under the sky, with a Bottle on, and the Bottle fills with that feeling.
catchWeather.how: Only feelings you have awakened to, and only if the Bottle's empty or already holds that one. Stronger weather fills it faster.

relay.label: Relay
relay.line: Hit a creature hard and the force carries on to the one behind it, up to three in a row.
relay.how: "Hard" means a thrown hit, or a blow of power 2 or more. Each link keeps three quarters of the force, and the next body has to be within 3 m, in line.

trueOdds.label: True Odds
trueOdds.line: See chance as real numbers. Near the Tithe's console you get the next pull's odds for each tier, pity included. Near a crystal you see what it might give.
trueOdds.how: These are the game's real odds, never rounded in your favour. More of the world's chances show up as you learn to read them.

borrowVerb.label: Borrow a Verb
borrowVerb.line: Reprogram a creature and you can use its move on R for 20 seconds, in place of your sub's.
borrowVerb.how: A slip jelly lends its spit glob, a Lantern Wisp its flame ball. Each throw costs 4 pool, and the loan ends if the lender goes down.

walkCycle.label: Walk the Cycle
walkCycle.line: Turn every affliction on the nearest foe into the one it beats: doubt into charm, charm into confusion, confusion into a stun, blindness into doubt.
walkCycle.how: Each keeps the time it had left, never more than the new one would last. A foe with no afflictions can't be walked.

sealCreature.label: A Seal on a Creature
sealCreature.line: Seal a creature as it winds up a blow. The blow breaks off, and it can't use that kind of blow for 20 seconds.
sealCreature.how: Only works mid-windup. A FOE follows its own rules and shrugs the seal off.

FEAT_WORDS.lateParry: blows parried at the last moment
FEAT_WORDS.shieldRun: runs of six blows on your shield unbroken
FEAT_WORDS.longRelease: fish let go after a long fight
FEAT_WORDS.twoAtOnce: two afflictions on one creature inside a second
FEAT_WORDS.titheRare: Tithe pulls of rare or better
FEAT_WORDS.parryReturn: shots parried back into their thrower

swap.label: your main and sub change places

noJump.label: never leave the ground by a jump
